rules: Terminal Navy canvas, BH Blue accents, hairlines not boxes, square corners, no drop shadows, no gradients on motifs.
One BHIL motif per figure: the dot constellation only on HS-01, the ASCII pipeline only on HS-03, the prompt chevron in the eyebrow everywhere else.
Retro specimens (pixel type, bevels, badges, counters, period colors) sit inside the BHIL frame as content, never as the frame.
Every animation is CSS, slow, small in area, stops under prefers-reduced-motion, and frame zero is the designed static frame.
No em dashes or en dashes; the repository dash gate scans every SVG.

figures.title: Retro-Web Redesign Engine
figures.alt: HOMESTEAD masthead: a dot-matrix HOMESTEAD wordmark over the BHIL dot constellation, with period badges for presets B, C, and E and Safe Mode.
figures.motion: Stars in the dot constellation twinkle slowly; the dot-matrix cursor blinks once per second.

figures.title: Six neighborhoods. One address per build.
figures.alt: Timeline from 1993 to 2026 showing the six HOMESTEAD era presets, with kits for GeoCities, FrontPage, and MySpace.
figures.motion: A highlight frame visits one era at a time, every two seconds.

figures.title: Seven phases. Every one leaves paper.
figures.alt: BHIL ASCII pipeline on an ink panel: intake, survey, era lock, map, assets, build, and audit, with owners, outputs, and the revise loop.
figures.motion: A block cursor steps through the seven phases, two seconds each.

figures.title: Inventory before era.
figures.alt: A modern page being scanned into an inventory window listing detected patterns, brand colors with web-safe snaps, fonts, and tone.
figures.motion: A scan line sweeps down the modern page every four seconds.

figures.title: Translate component by component.
figures.alt: Table mapping six modern patterns to their GeoCities, FrontPage, and MySpace equivalents, each with a period badge.
figures.motion: A highlight frame steps down the six rows.

figures.title: Every glyph drawn here. Nothing borrowed.
figures.alt: The 216-color web-safe cube with BHIL brand colors snapped to it, beside real gifsmith outputs: a badge, a construction sign, odometer digits, nav buttons, glitter text, and the pixel font.
figures.motion: The construction sign and glitter specimens play their real frames at 600 ms and 400 ms.

figures.title: View Source never lies.
figures.alt: A period source window with a web font, rounded corners, and modern copy flagged by the HOMESTEAD era lint, beside the lint report.
figures.motion: Flagged lines pulse copper; the editor cursor blinks.

figures.title: Keep the chaos. Give it an off switch.
figures.alt: The same period page as built, with starfield, marquee, and blinking badge, and in Safe Mode as plain black text on white.
figures.motion: Only the as-built side moves: twinkling stars, a slow marquee, and a once-per-second NEW badge.

figures.title: Graded blind. Scored to forty.
figures.alt: Odometer showing 39 of 40 for the Nimbus Ledger 1998 build, the twenty rubric rows with their scores, the score bands, and the hard gates.

figures.title: The crew's Top 8. One of them can't write.
figures.alt: Profile-style friend grid of the human director, the orchestrator, and six subagents with their tools, the auditor marked read only.
figures.motion: The orchestrator's ONLINE NOW badge blinks once per second.
